source: Authenticated Robinhood Banking MCP tools/list contract

tools.name: banking_get_agent_card_balance
tools.description: Get the current month's spending balance for the user's Robinhood agent virtual credit card.

tools.name: banking_get_agent_card_creds
tools.description: Get the PAN, expiry, CVV, and cardholder billing details for the user's Robinhood agent virtual credit card.

tools.name: banking_get_agent_card_policy
tools.description: Get the spending policy for the user's Robinhood agent virtual credit card.

tools.name: banking_get_agent_card_status
tools.description: Get the current status of the user's Robinhood agent virtual credit card.

tools.name: banking_get_agent_card_transactions
tools.description: Get transaction history for the user's Robinhood agent virtual credit card.

tools.name: banking_submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit feedback about the Robinhood banking MCP tools or the user's agent virtual card.

tools.name: banking_wait_for_agent_card_approval
tools.description: Wait for the user to approve or reject a skippably-declined agent-card transaction.
